events.info: The Movement Social is a full-day celebration of health, movement, and community --- all happening at The Refinery (1640 Meeting Street)!!! We're bringing together fitness, wellness, and lifestyle brands to give you the ultimate experience in feeling good inside and out. Kick off the morning with DJMikeTech before our 3 different workout classes lined up. Jump into one OR two of these energizing fitness classes starting at 9:15AM and stay throughout the morning for recovery, shopping, music, and a good time! From workouts and recovery experiences to product demos, samples, and exclusive shopping --- this is your chance to connect with the best of Charleston's fitness and wellness scene. Whether you're sweating it out, discovering new health-focused brands, or taking home some extra goodies, the Movement Social is all about celebrating YOU! Workout Class Schedule (each class is 35 minutes each): 9:15AM Jibe Cycling Studio 10AM Legion Performance Club 10:45AM Jane. Do SCULPT General Admission tickets includes - Live DJ experience all morning, wellness demos, freebies, & shopping with our local vendors. General Admission + 2 workout classes tickets includes - 2 workout classes of your choice and live DJ experience all morning, wellness demos, freebies, & shopping with our local vendors. boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: We are open Thursday & Friday from 10am-3pm ET. On event days, we are also open 2 hours before the scheduled show time.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: We are a completely cashless facility, and only accept major credit/debit cards.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Patrons who have tickets being held at Will Call may pick up their tickets during normal box office hours (see above). Patrons must present a valid photo ID that matches the name on the order to pick up the tickets

venues.parkingDetail: Parking is conveniently located in the public parking garage situated next to the Charleston Music Hall between the Hall and the Hampton Inn. There is an entrance from John Street, and an entrance from Hutson St. Additional parking garages are located one block North at the Charleston Visitor's Center Parking Garage in between Ann St. and Mary St. and one block South next to the Francis Marion Hotel at 399 King St. Metered street parking is also available throughout the area.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Yes, this is an accessible venue. Customers must contact the venue Box Office at 843-853-2252 to purchase.

generalInfo.generalRule: All bags brought into the facility must be clear (small clutches are OK, but subject to search). We do not allow outside food or beverages because our bar inside is phenomenal. Leave your weapons at home. For more info about our venue policies, please visit: www.charlestonmusichall.com/faqs
generalInfo.childRule: Yes, but everyone that needs a seat needs a ticket. Infants that do not require a seat do not need a ticket.
